---
title: 'SMS prices'
description: 'The price Nomad shows before an SMS leaves, for each destination.'
---

The price is the route cost plus 25 percent, rounded up to the cent. Nomad shows that price and waits for acceptance before the message leaves. SMS Services must be connected. Nothing is charged before that.

Each price is shown in EUR, XOF, and USD. 1 EUR is 655.96 XOF. 1 USD is 605 XOF. The charge is taken from the balance that can cover it, XOF first. Login codes and payment notices from lomi. are not on this list and are not billed to the business.
